title: Pin Rescue: Lost Treasure
theme: ancient subterranean ruins and volcanic chambers
visualStyle: 3D stylized cartoon with rich warm lighting and fluid physics

targetAudience.demographics: Casual players 22-55, high female and male appeal

coreMechanics: pull golden pins in exact logical sequence
redirect lethal molten lava streams away from treasure chambers
pour clean water onto magma to turn it into harmless solid granite
drop boulder traps to neutralize lurking dungeon goblins
failStates: lava breaches the lower barrier and burns the adventurer
molten rock incinerates the chest of ancient gold relics
pulling the wrong pin frees goblins into the sanctuary
water barrier breached causing flooded dead end
satisfyingMoments: water splashing into bubbling lava causing a hiss and turning into solid stone
giant waterfall of 10,000 sparkling gold coins filling the victory chest
domino reaction where 4 pins release simultaneously to trap all monsters
hero doing a joyful victory dance with celebratory fanfare
uniqueSellingPoints: real physics simulation for water, lava, and acid fluids
over 400 hand-crafted brainteaser puzzles without artificial paywalls
satisfying tactile sound design on every pin release
offline play support with zero mandatory video ads

winningHooks: Why did 99% fail to pull the blue pin first?
Help him before the lava reaches the chest!
